Familiarity with congressional process and procedure.

Creativity, drive, and confidence to propose original and compelling legislative work, including drafting legislation, hearing questions, and oversight letters.
This is not an entry level position.

description: The Office of Congressional Ethics (OCE), an independent, non-partisan investigative entity established by the United States House of Representatives, seeks one attorney with 5-10 years of experience to serve as Investigative Counsel. The OCE is seeking attorneys interested in the OCE's work supporting ethics and transparency within the House of Representatives. The Investigative Counsel would join a small, Washington, DC-based, investigative team, and would be eligible to apply for hybrid work accommodations combining in-person core days and remote work.
